entry_state: Chapter 9 closes with the consequence of changing a framework, withholding adoption evidence, changing the reporting year or merely renaming a label. The operating methods and real-disclosure tests support specific conditional treatments, while current authority, entity elections and broader method coverage remain open. The next chapter will extend the company through financing, ownership and reporting boundaries.
exit_state: Debt contracts, carrying measurements and cash flows require separate records. Apple's principal, cash and hedge adjustments do not identify all movements; net borrowing can hide refinancing. Disclosed sensitivities retain their population and measure, and derivative VaR is not net company currency risk. The equity section now introduces security quantities, monetary equity and dated per-share calculations, which continue next.
findings: The debt opening distinguishes coupon-bearing and later zero-coupon instruments and separates legal terms from accounting measurements.
The annual debt cash reconciliation exposes an unallocated 727 difference and measurement changes 35/755 without naming them as transactions.
A hypothetical 60-day borrowing has zero net principal flow but interest 25/3; matching the net financing row does not establish intraperiod liquidity.
The rate scenario contrasts observed annual sensitivity with an invalid notional shortcut and keeps annual interest, fair value and one-day derivative VaR distinct. No new confirmed defect.
